title: The Cross-Lingual Cost: Retrieval Biases in RAG over Arabic-English Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing domain-specific English-Arabic benchmarks with parallel documents and systematically varying the languages of the user query and the ground-truth document. The paper measures the performance drop (using metrics like Hits@20, NDCG@20, MRR@20, and LLM-as-a-judge accuracy) in cross-lingual retrieval setups compared to same-language setups, evaluating the tendency of retrievers to favor high-resource languages or same-language matches over cross-lingual matches.
